summary: Full end-to-end verification (backend + frontend) of Vesper Settings v2 features: rail↔content D-pad keyboard nav, Playback/Home section reorg, Add-a-category flow (genre chip + custom text + no-results), custom-row management (up/toggle/remove), Home-page rendering of custom rails, home-rows-reset regression, and Search regression. All acceptance criteria PASS. Backend /api/tmdb/custom-row returns correct label/matched/media/data for 'horror and comedy', 'superhero series', 'sports movies', 'zzqxjv' (empty data) and 422 on empty q.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx is still ~1800+ lines. Now includes AddCategoryPanel/HomeRowsPanel on top of existing sections. Recommend factoring HomeRowsPanel + AddCategoryPanel into /pages/settings/homeRows/*.jsx for maintainability.
homeRows.js addCustomHomeRow uses slug from query, so 'Horror' chip creates id 'custom:horror' — matches spec. Good.
No aria-checked exposed on Home behaviour toggle buttons; consider adding role=switch + aria-checked for a11y (values only inferable via visual state).
seed_data_creation: sessionStorage vesper-e2e=1 via ?e2e=1; localStorage onnowtv-profiles-v1[:testuser] + onnowtv-active-profile-v1[:testuser] for p-test-1; vesper-onboarding-seen-v1; onnowtv-whatsnew-seen-v1=9.9.9; onnowtv-home-rows-v1:p-test-1 preset for Home rendering check.

verified_scenarios.keynav_theme_right_left: PASS — settings-nav-theme → ArrowRight lands on theme-electric; ArrowLeft returns to settings-nav-theme
verified_scenarios.keynav_home_right_left: PASS — settings-nav-home → ArrowRight into [data-settings-section=home] home-row-cw-down; ArrowLeft loop returns to settings-nav-home
verified_scenarios.keynav_playback_right_left: PASS — settings-nav-playback → ArrowRight to toggle-autoplay-1080p; ArrowLeft back to settings-nav-playback
verified_scenarios.section_reorg_playback: PASS — playback testids = [toggle-autoplay-1080p, toggle-force-sdr, player-backend-row/exo/libvlc]; NO toggle-auto-trailer, NO toggle-top-nav-layout, NO toggle-show-collections anywhere in DOM
verified_scenarios.section_reorg_home_behaviour: PASS — 'Home behaviour' heading present in home section; toggle-top-nav-layout and toggle-auto-trailer render and flip on click
verified_scenarios.add_category_genre_horror: PASS — panel closes, home-row-custom-horror appears at position 10 with up/down/toggle/remove; Horror chip disabled on re-open
verified_scenarios.add_category_custom_text_sports_movies: PASS — submit shows loading state, home-row-custom-sports-movies appears with label 'Sports'; localStorage custom=[{id:custom:horror,label:Horror,query:Horror},{id:custom:sports-movies,label:Sports,query:'sports movies'}] and ids at end of order
verified_scenarios.add_category_no_results_zzqxjv: PASS — [data-testid=add-category-error] shows 'Couldn't find enough titles for "zzqxjv"…'; no row added
verified_scenarios.custom_row_reorder_up: PASS — sports-movies-up moved custom:sports-movies above custom:horror in order
verified_scenarios.custom_row_toggle_hide: PASS — custom-horror-toggle causes 'Hidden' text in row
verified_scenarios.custom_row_remove: PASS — custom-horror-remove deletes row; localStorage.custom no longer contains it; Horror chip enabled again in panel
verified_scenarios.home_renders_custom_row: PASS — with sports-movies at index 0, [data-testid=custom-row-shelf-sports-movies] renders as first rail after hero, title 'Sports', ~80 poster-tile elements (>= expected ~40 tiles)
verified_scenarios.studios_rail_still_renders: PASS — Studios rail present on Home (no pref gating)
verified_scenarios.home_rows_reset_clears_custom: PASS — reset restores default order, hidden=[], custom=[]
verified_scenarios.search_regression: PASS — search-input auto-focus; typing 'top gun' surfaces [data-testid=search-suggestions] within a few seconds
verified_scenarios.backend_custom_row_horror_and_comedy: PASS — label='Horror & Comedy', matched.genres={Horror,Comedy}, matched.media=['movie'], 8 items with tmdb_id/type/title/poster

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/tmdb/custom-row responses are fast (~1.7s for full 5-test suite). Add-category submit inserts a loading state ('Finding…') then the row appears — allow up to ~15s. Home renders custom rows via [data-testid=custom-row-shelf-<slug>] where slug replaces spaces with '-' (e.g. sports-movies). The reset button in HomeRowsPanel is a single-click reset (no two-tap confirm needed). Toggles in Home behaviour section do not expose aria-checked — verify state visually or via the internal input.checked.
rca of the issue: No defects found; all Round-93 acceptance criteria met on both frontend and backend.
